content:
Let \(G\) be initial grass (cow-days) and \(g\) be daily growth (cow-days/day).

\[
20\cdot 40 = G + 40g \Rightarrow 800 = G + 40g
\]
\[
35\cdot 10 = G + 10g \Rightarrow 350 = G + 10g
\]

Subtract:

\[
450 = 30g \Rightarrow g = 15
\]

Then:

\[
350 = G + 150 \Rightarrow G = 200
\]

For 25 cows lasting \(d\) days:

\[
25d = 200 + 15d
\]

\[
10d = 200 \Rightarrow d = 20
\]

\boxed{20}
